mapper.select: SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, summary, summarized_message_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM CONVERSATIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, conversation_id DESC

SELECT conversation_id, user_id, title, summary, summarized_message_id, status, created_at, updated_at FROM CONVERSATIONS WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CONVERSATIONS ( user_id, title, status, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{title}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE CONVERSATIONS SET title = CASE WHEN title = '새 채팅' THEN #{title} ELSE title END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId}
UPDATE CONVERSATIONS SET summary = #{summary}, summarized_message_id = #{summarizedMessageId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE conversation_id = #{conversationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
